mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.0%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and supporting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0% and increasing by >0.3pp over 3 months) signals labor market weakness, triggering recession fears and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.0% and UNRATE change > 0.3pp over 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) by >0.5% in the last month indicate broad demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days due to recession risks.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of interaction events, or interaction effect p-value > 0.05 in regression.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105.0) signals strong manufacturing activity and economic expansion, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of INDPRO > 105.0 periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer spending (RSAFS above 12-month moving average) indicates robust household demand, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >50% of RSAFS above 12-month MA periods, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 4.0% for 2 consecutive months) signals the need for monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as discount rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >50% of CPIAUCSL > 4.0% for 2 months periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS) and rises in unemployment (UNRATE) by >0.5% and >0.2pp respectively in the last month indicate labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of interaction events, or interaction effect p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) signal restrictive monetary policy, increasing discount rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of FEDFUNDS > 5.0% periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.
